summary: # CLO Techniques Workshop - Exporting 3D Format Files ## Introduction to OPT File Export Hello everyone, today I will introduce you to the export of OPT files. First of all, I will discuss the relevant settings for exporting OPT files. ## Exporting OPT Files In the main menu bar, you can export the completed file as OPT. If you only want to export some of the content, you can first select the required version, model, etc. Then, click the "OPT selected" below, and select "Export OPT." 1. **Select Save Address**: Choose the appropriate save address and enter the desired file name. Click "Save." 2. **OPT Window Settings**: When the OPT window appears, let's take a look at the specific settings. ### Export Selection Contents The top three rows in the export selection include: - Version - Virtual model - Postage and copy The square on the left can be freely selected, and the arrow symbol button on the right can be opened. You can select a single target to save the content you just selected as an object. Selecting multiple targets can divide the content into multiple objects. ### Merge vs. Unmerge The main difference between merge and unmerge is reflected in the seam line. The grid point of the seam line can be exported as one point or exported separately. ### Rendering Thickness and UV Coordinates - The thick option below can save the rendering thickness of the version. - Common UV coordinates can be selected, and the UV images can be exported as well. We will release a detailed UV image video in the future. ### Hidden Objects and Internal Images Take a look at the hidden objects, such as a hidden model. Selecting this option can also export the model. If it is not selected, the hidden model or version will not be exported. - **Insert Internal Images**: Export files can include internal lines and internal images. Here, you can set the size of the object, change the unit, and adjust the proportion. ### Axis Conversion The axis conversion allows the file to rotate in the direction of the three axes, represented as the XYZ axis in 3D space. ### Saving Flag Colors After selecting to save the flag color, it will save each flag color as an object file. Save to the path in the original text, which means saving both the text and the object to the initially selected path. ### Compression Package When saving with the text file, it will generate a compression package in the selected path. This package will contain object files and text images, etc. After connecting the color and text together, the color will merge into the text image. ### Using Object Files in Model Software If the object file is to be used in model software, it will use this option, which can store files other than the environment color and the environment image. ### Saving Transparent Images Save the transparent image from the slow reflection image. When the material contains a transparent image, click on this option to save the transparent image. Even if you don't click on it, the transparent effect can be retained. ### Saving MetaData There is only one separate transparent image. Save the metadata, including clothing pages, grid, physical properties, and sewage information, as MetaDataXML. ## Exporting FBX Files The main menu bar allows for file export as FBX. Click "Save" to open the FBX window. ### FBX Export Options When exporting, you can choose whether you need a virtual model or not. The menu can be set to exclude the model skeleton. The following settings are the same as those for exporting ARP to the front. 1. **Scene and Props**: After selecting the scene and props, you can also save the scene and others. 2. **Model Action**: If the model has an action, you can choose to save it. Connect has recently launched many new actions, which are available for download and use. ### Cache Animation You can save recorded costume animation as storage data. There are two types of files: - **Cache Animation MC**: This file is saved as 2-key and cannot be opened by the user. - **S-key**: This file is saved as a file and can be opened by the user. ### FBX SDK Recommendations It is recommended to use the default version, which is the highest version 2020, as higher versions can be integrated downwards. ### Comparison of Saved Text Images As with previous settings, the saved text image is a relative file path; only the saved text name is saved, and the saved text image path is not saved. Therefore, if the saved FBX and the file used in the text image are under the same path, the text image will automatically be added. ### Absolute File Path Cache Animation MC saves the text image as an absolute file path. If you change the path of the text image, it will not be able to be imported into the media, and the text image will be wrapped in the FBX file. In this text image mode, even if the FBX text image path is moved, the text can still be normally added. ### Color and Principle When the color is applied to the principle, the color and the principle will merge and be saved. FBX files cannot contain all the data, including principle pictures and colors. Therefore, select the option to export the color information applied to the principle. ## Exporting GLTF2.0 and GLB Next, I will introduce the export for GLTF2.0 and GLB formats. The settings for this export are similar to the previous options, with a few additional features. ### Light Line and Costume Animation Light lines, except for rendering light lines, can be exported together with the light. Additionally, costume animation data can be exported. The rest of the settings have been previously mentioned, so I will not repeat them here. ### Transparent Value on Metal Roughness Chart Finally, I will add another function: select the transparent value on the metal roughness chart, and an extra green chart will be added. ## Conclusion This concludes the overview of exporting techniques for OPT, FBX, and GLTF2.0 file formats. Thank you for your attention, and I look forward to seeing you in our next session!
